propositions.name: ethereal_medium_fills_space
propositions.statement: There is an ethereal medium filling space and permeating bodies capable of being set in motion.

propositions.name: medium_has_real_density
propositions.statement: The pervading medium has small but real density.

propositions.name: propagation_finite_velocity
propositions.statement: Motion transmitted through the medium propagates with a great but not infinite velocity.

propositions.name: communication_occupies_time
propositions.statement: The communication of motion through the medium is not instantaneous but occupies time.

propositions.name: instant_across_whole_medium
propositions.statement: There is an instant at which the amount of energy in the whole medium is a definite quantity equally divided.

propositions.name: energy_existed_in_medium_before
propositions.statement: The energy that heats the body must have formerly existed in the moving medium before the undulations reached the body.

propositions.name: time_of_transit_defined
propositions.statement: There is a time during which the undulations travel from the source of heat to the body.

propositions.name: body_motion_through_field
propositions.statement: A body has a definite motion through the electromagnetic field which produces electromotive force.

propositions.name: mechanism_subject_to_dynamics
propositions.statement: The mechanism of the medium is subject to the general laws of Dynamics.

propositions.name: two_kinds_of_energy_only
propositions.statement: The medium stores two kinds of energy: actual energy depending on motion of its parts and potential energy of elastic connections.

propositions.name: half_and_half_energy_division
propositions.statement: At any instant half the energy in the whole medium is energy of motion and half is elastic resilience.

propositions.name: parts_of_medium_connected
propositions.statement: The parts of the medium are so connected that the motion of one part depends on the motion of the rest.

propositions.name: magnetic_force_direction_as_axis
propositions.statement: The direction of the magnetic force serves as the axis of a rotation of the ethereal medium.

propositions.name: electrical_velocity_matches_light
propositions.statement: The velocity of propagation from electrical experiments is so nearly that of light that light itself is an electromagnetic disturbance.

propositions.name: ratio_of_units_is_velocity
propositions.statement: The number of electrostatic units of electricity contained in one electromagnetic unit is the velocity of propagation.

propositions.name: refraction_squared_equals_product
propositions.statement: In dense transparent bodies the square of the index of refraction equals the product of the specific dielectric capacity and the specific magnetic capacity.

propositions.name: relative_velocity_well_defined
propositions.statement: The force between two particles depends on their relative velocity, which is treated as a definite quantity.

propositions.name: body_motion_causes_electromotive_force
propositions.statement: When a body is moved across the lines of magnetic force it experiences an electromotive force.

propositions.name: only_transverse_disturbances_propagate
propositions.statement: The only disturbances which can be propagated through a non-conductive field are those transverse to the direction of propagation.

propositions.name: electric_displacement_is_elastic_yielding
propositions.statement: Electric displacement is a kind of elastic yielding to the action of electromotive force.

propositions.name: elasticity_agrees_across_processes
propositions.statement: The elasticity of the medium calculated from rapid luminous vibrations agrees with that found by the slow process of electrical experiments.

propositions.name: energy_alternates_between_forms
propositions.statement: The propagation of undulations consists in the continual transformation of one form of energy into the other alternately.

propositions.name: same_medium_for_light_and_em
propositions.statement: The elastic medium through which the vibrations of light are propagated is the same medium in which the cause of other electromagnetic phenomena is to be sought.

propositions.name: unit_ratio_equals_light_velocity
propositions.statement: The number of electrostatic units in one electromagnetic unit of electricity should be equal to the velocity of light in air or vacuum.

propositions.name: orbit_radius_combines_with_aberration
propositions.statement: The coefficient of aberration and the received value of the radius of the earth's orbit may be combined to yield the velocity of light in the space surrounding the earth.

propositions.name: wave_propagates_same_in_either_direction
propositions.statement: The wave is propagated in either direction through the field with the same value of the velocity V.

propositions.name: only_transverse_vibrations_propagate
propositions.statement: The equations of the electromagnetic field, deduced from purely experimental evidence, show that transversal vibrations only can be propagated.

propositions.name: em_and_optics_give_same_velocity
propositions.statement: Electromagnetic science and optical science both affirm the propagation of transverse vibrations and both give the same velocity of propagation.

propositions.name: specific_inductive_capacity_equals_index_squared
propositions.statement: The Specific Inductive Capacity is equal to the square of the index of refraction divided by the coefficient of magnetic induction.

propositions.name: magnetic_and_elastic_axes_coincide
propositions.statement: In a crystallized medium the axes of magnetic induction coincide in direction with those of electric elasticity.

propositions.name: principal_plane_ray_isotropic_velocity
propositions.statement: In each principal plane of a crystal the ray polarized in that plane has the same velocity in whatever direction in that plane it is propagated.

propositions.name: conduction_transforms_energy_to_heat
propositions.statement: In a conductor, true currents of conduction transform electrical energy into heat, and the undulation is thereby weakened.

propositions.name: gold_transparency_requires_reduced_optical_loss
propositions.statement: The observed transmission of light through gold-leaf cannot be reconciled with the electromagnetic theory unless there is less loss of energy when electromotive forces reverse with the rapidity of the vibrations of light than when they act for sensible times.

propositions.name: magnetization_direction_in_plane_of_wave
propositions.statement: The direction of the magnetization must be in the plane of the wave.

propositions.name: vibrations_countable_per_second
propositions.statement: The electromotive and magnetic forces of light are reversed a definite number of times per second, more than a thousand million million.

propositions.name: energy_half_magnetic_half_electric
propositions.statement: Half of the energy per unit of volume in the light wave consists of magnetic and half of electric energy.

propositions.name: agreement_implies_common_substance
propositions.statement: The agreement of the electromagnetic and optical results shows that light and magnetism are affections of the same substance and that light is an electromagnetic disturbance propagated through the field according to electromagnetic laws.

propositions.name: electromotive_force_from_time_variation
propositions.statement: The electromotive forces in the field are due to the variations either of the electromagnetic or the electrostatic functions, since there is no motion of conductors in the field.

propositions.name: no_evidence_for_density_of_electricity
propositions.statement: There is no evidence as to the density of electricity, and it is not known whether to consider vitreous electricity as a substance or as the absence of a substance.

propositions.name: perfect_dielectric_no_true_conduction
propositions.statement: In a perfect dielectric there is no true conduction, and the currents p prime, q prime, r prime are only variations in the electric displacement.

propositions.name: second_order_aether_wind_effect
propositions.statement: A relative velocity of the aether equal to the earth's orbital velocity would increase the round-trip transmission time by about one hundred-millionth of the whole.

propositions.name: medium_distinct_from_gross_matter
propositions.statement: The medium through which light is propagated is distinct from the transparent gross matter known to us.

propositions.name: energy_resides_in_medium
propositions.statement: The energy of radiation is not transmitted instantaneously but exists for a certain time in the medium during transit.

propositions.name: aether_elasticity_and_density
propositions.statement: The aether possesses elasticity similar to that of a solid body and has a finite density.

propositions.name: substances_do_not_annihilate
propositions.statement: Two bodies put together cannot annihilate each other.

propositions.name: light_is_process_in_substance
propositions.statement: Light is not itself a substance but a process going on in a substance.

propositions.name: phase_defined_at_x_and_t
propositions.statement: The phase of the process is a well-defined function of a distance x from a fixed point and a time t.

propositions.name: interplanetary_space_filled_with_aether
propositions.statement: The interplanetary and interstellar spaces are not empty but are occupied by a material substance.

propositions.name: aether_velocity_relative_to_solar_system
propositions.statement: The aether has a definite relative velocity with respect to the solar system that can in principle be determined.

propositions.name: direction_of_earths_orbital_motion
propositions.statement: The earth's motion in its orbit has a definite direction in space that a laboratory apparatus can be aligned with.

propositions.name: vector_process_perpendicular_to_ray
propositions.statement: The physical process in the propagation of light is a directed vector quantity at right angles to the ray.
